command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
review="$reports/review-code.md"
added=$(git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- "$review" | tail -1)
base=HEAD
[ -z "$added" ] || base="$added^"
touched=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -vxF "$review" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$touched" ] || { echo "$touched"; echo "the review-code stage writes nothing but $review - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2's Fix tells the next stage to move the failure/dismissal scenarios into `app_shell_silent_update_failures_unit.feature`. That new aspect has no `_e2e` pair, and `.claude/rules/bdd-unit.md` says "The `_unit` suffix is added only when a paired `_e2e` file exists for the same aspect" (the Fix itself says "Keep the `_unit` suffix only on features with an `_e2e` pair"). Following the example would create a misnamed feature and steps file. The example should be `app_shell_silent_update_failures.feature` with `steps/app_shell_silent_update_failures.steps.ts`, and the same applies to the suggested own feature for the silent-update scenarios split out of `app_shell_zone_rules_notice_unit.feature`.
